answer: Make trust a graft, not a seedling anyone can plant: a newcomer must graft its identity onto an existing orchard tree owned by an unrelated veteran, and the graft takes a full season to take, checked at every ledge of growth by harbor inspectors who verify the graft is alive and bearing real work. A graft binds to one key, so a copy shows the same branch twice and is pruned. Harbor audits re-check grafted trees each epoch, freezing any whose fruit is faked. Sybil farms must fund a graft, wait out the season, and pass fresh inspectors for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
